items.reason: The initial interim RFS benefit was not sustained on updated analysis (updated RFS HR 1.26, 95% CI 0.85–1.87); the NCCN HCC Version 2.2026 Insights states that the recommendation was subsequently removed and that there is no adjuvant strategy at this time.
items.action: Retain the initial and updated reports together as one study; use as contrary/withdrawn-recommendation evidence in a dedicated review, not as a new trial page.

items.primary_title: Nivolumab plus ipilimumab combined with chemotherapy as first-line treatment for HER2-negative unresectable advanced or recurrent gastric/gastroesophageal junction cancer: A randomized phase 3 trial (ATTRACTION-6)
items.reason: The phase III primary OS endpoint was not met: median OS 15.7 vs 15.8 months; HR 0.90 (95.8% CI 0.74–1.09), P=0.267. Grade ≥3 AEs were 80.0% vs 62.4% and grade ≥3 treatment-related AEs 64.8% vs 42.9%.
items.action: Retain as negative/contrary evidence for first-line HER2-negative advanced gastric/GEJ cancer; do not promote as a positive practice-changing trial page. Reassess if a full peer-reviewed report changes the evidence.
